text:
eli: Heads-up — follow-up from last night's prod OOM. Heap drift on kv-shard-7 looked linear over ~12h, not a single spike.
maya: Yep, saw similar. KV slab churn + increasing fragmentation. jemalloc stats show rising retained > rss delta.
samir: I started continuous heap profiling on shard-7 around 02:15. Uploading flamegraphs to /artifacts/heap/179950 — will link when ready.
rachel: Opening follow-up tasks now. We should separate short-term mitigations from long-term fixes (profiling/playback + allocator tuning).
eli: Proposed action list (short):
- A1: Long-running heap profile & differential analysis (owner: samir, due: 2026-04-07)
- A2: Emergency eviction cap on kv-shard-7 to limit memory growth (owner: maya, due: 2026-04-02)
- A3: Add synthetic load + alarm (memory delta > 200MB/30m) to catch regressions (owner: kevin, due: 2026-04-03)
- A4: Run jemalloc arena and purge experiments on staging (owner: samir, due: 2026-04-09)
- A5: Update runbook with fragmentation signs & remediation checklist (owner: rachel, due: 2026-04-10)
maya: For A2 I'll push a temporary per-shard cap: config kv.eviction.max_bytes_per_shard. Will draft a short RFC for rollback criteria.
samir: Profiling notes: run `sudo perf record -F 200 -a -- ./kv-service --shard 7` then `./scripts/flamegraph.sh perf.data > shard7.svg`. For heap dumps: `gcore $(pidof kv-service)` then `heaptrack -o /tmp/heap.track <pid>`.
kevin: I'll wire the alarm into ops-alerts and add a synthetic that replays the problematic workload from the incident trace. If alarm lands, it should open INC-5421 and ping #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-30T02:05 UTC completed for staging (tag: heap-experiments).
rachel: Recurring pattern note: this is the 3rd time in 6 months we've seen steady drift on different shards after high write bursts. We should track whether compaction/eviction changes correlate.
eli: Good catch. Let's track a metric: `kv.heap_retained_delta_1h` and roll it into the daily infra digest so platform teams see it.
maya: I'll prototype a small benchmark to reproduce slab churn locally (sending variable key sizes + delete patterns). Will post results in this thread.
samir: Adding to A1: include jemalloc stats, pmap changes, and a baseline from a known-good build.
kevin: Can someone add the incident number to each task? rachel, can you link the postmortem?
rachel: Postmortem link: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-5421-memory-kv-shard7. Tickets created: RW-2341 (profiling), RW-2342 (eviction cap), RW-2343 (synthetic & alerts), RW-2344 (runbook).
eli: Cool — weekly check-in on these during eng-runtime triage until closed. If anyone hits blockers, @eli or @rachel — escalate. :thumbsup:
kevin: ack. I'll try to get synthetic running by EOD tomorrow.
maya: pushing eviction cap PR now: https://git.redwood/infra/PR-589.
samir: Flamegraph uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/heap/179950/shard7.svg — main hotspots point to kv::insert/compact and a small leak in slice cache.
rachel: Thanks. I'll fold that into the runbook draft and assign reviewers from eng-runtime + eng-platform.
eli: Great progress. Let's keep updates brief in this thread (status + blockers).
